The witness 'Rousseau - Philosophie, 1823.djvu' has page footnotes with '↑' backlinks: Nicaragua animal and 'Juven, sat. XV, V. 131.' in Part 1, Pascal in Part 2. original-fr appends them to 3.51 (87 words incl. '↑') and 4.66 (39), leaving calls '[1]' 3.11, '[2]' 3.34, '[1]' 4.0; no '↑' in other editions. The 1782 Geneva edition t1 p.73 has the Nicaragua note as Rousseau's footnote, but p.105 (Part 2 opening) has none, so the Pascal note is later editorial matter.

new_observations.note: The shard manifest (primary-view TOC) has English chapter titles for 91/96 chapters (e.g. 'Chapter 6 — Judicial Power In The United States'); the whole-book JSON has Danish titles ('Kapitel 6 — Den dømmende magt i USA'). Paragraph text is identical. Contradicts the G09-06 side-claim that the other sharded editions match their JSON.
Shard/JSON drift: modern-en shards wrap 117 paragraphs in ["…"] and modern-da wraps 178 in […]. In addition, 69.547 and 69.612 have different verse renderings in shard and JSON (both editions).

The etext editor's aside '(If a man hate superstition he cannot love religion. D.W.)' (pg3600 l.39017) is served in modern-en without 'D.W.', so it reads as Montaigne's own and contradicts his preceding sentence. Aggravates G09-essays-montaigne-02.

The Discourse title ('A DISSERTATION / ON THE ORIGIN…', fr 'L’ORIGINE ET LES FONDEMENTS…') and exordium ('It is of man that I have to speak…', 'O man, of whatever country…') are served inside the 'Preface/Préface' chapter. This follows source order but mislabels the exordium.
Scattered paragraphs outside ch7-9 are still byte-identical to original-en, including 111-word ch15.35 and 107-word ch14.76. The staged candidate reduces ch15 to 6 identical paragraphs.

The bracketed passage '[Now Homer shews us clearly enough how surprise gives the advantage…]' (68 words, indented block in pg3600 l.43405) is of unclear status (possibly Cotton's addition). It was not counted in the G09-essays-montaigne-02 extent.
